acceptance.given: The historical artifact under test and its baseline receipt are available, and a verification fixture can attempt only the specified rename or delete mutation.

oracle.expected: The verification run records rejection of the rename/delete mutation and demonstrates that every non-target input byte, manifest entry, and fixture control remains identical between control and mutation cases.
forbidden: The verification fixture includes uncontrolled changes to other inputs.
The verification does not isolate the rename/delete attempt.
oracle.observable: A test result from the isolated mutation fixture shows the target rename/delete attempt rejected, with a deterministic comparison proving all non-target inputs are unchanged.

acceptance.then: The recorded evidence establishes isolated rename/delete rejection with all other inputs held constant.
acceptance.when: Verifying rejection of historical mutation through rename or delete attempts.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the NFR-5 mutation verification when the fixture mutates any non-target input or control value; the check must fail because the comparison is not isolated.
Run the NFR-5 verification with a rename/delete attempt that is not isolated from baseline inputs; the targeted test must fail rather than recording acceptance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Strengthen the NFR-5 verification path so rename and delete rejection is exercised through an isolated fixture and non-target input equality is asserted.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Test and validator behavior remains compatible with existing acceptance manifest and historical-artifact schemas; rollback removes only the added isolation assertions.

slice_hint.state_transition: Verification moves from unestablished isolation to a recorded, deterministic rename/delete rejection result with non-target inputs held constant.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted NFR-5 test passes and its output contains the isolated-fixture and non-target-constancy assertions for the rename/delete attempt.
